entities.name: Eskil
entities.description: A benevolent pacifist planeswalker of Dominaria, adopted son of Xarl, who ascended after Trine's blood blinded him and became guardian of the White Woods.

entities.name: Xarl Angel-Keeper
entities.description: Wizard who corrupted the angel Trine and adopted Eskil.

entities.name: Eska
entities.description: Ancestor of Eskil from Golthonor.

entities.name: Elazar
entities.description: Eskil's real father, who became a Duke on giving his son to Xarl.

entities.name: Trine
entities.description: Angel corrupted by Xarl, whose blood splashed Eskil.

entities.name: Rahel
entities.description: Serra Angel summoned by Eskil to fight Trine.

entities.name: White Woods
entities.description: Woods Eskil guards.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: Eskil's mentee.

entities.name: Embereck
entities.description: Ash Warlord convinced by Eskil to oppose Ravidel.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Planeswalker in thousand-year-old conflict with Embereck.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Device tied to Embereck's past.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Where Eskil transported himself and Embereck.

entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: War during which Embereck destroyed Eskil's hut.

entities.name: Absolution of Trine
entities.description: Event in which Eskil summoned Rahel to fight Trine and free northern Corondor.

entities.name: Enslavement of Trine
entities.description: Event during which Eskil was born.

entities.name: Blackblade-Dihada War
entities.description: War in which Eskil saved the children of Corondor.

entities.name: Shikaran survivors
entities.description: Survivors of Shikar's fall whom Eskil helped flee.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Aided by Eskil in freeing Daria.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: Freed from her Amber Prison.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Worked with Eskil to restore Corondor.

events.summary: Eskil summons the Serra Angel Rahel to fight Trine; Trine's blood blinds him, bleaches his skin and hair, and he ascends as a planeswalker.
events.quote: When Trine's blood splashed him, Eskil was blinded, his skin and hair were bleached white, and he ascended as a planeswalker .

events.summary: Eskil becomes guardian of the White Woods.
events.quote: Later, Eskil became the guardian of the White Woods .

events.summary: Eskil saves the children of Corondor during the Blackblade-Dihada War.
events.quote: he saved the children of Corondor during the Blackblade–Dihada War

events.summary: During the Planeswalker War, Embereck destroys Eskil's hut and Eskil takes both to New Argive, where he convinces Embereck to oppose Ravidel.
events.quote: Eskil helped convince Embereck to oppose Ravidel

events.summary: Eskil helps Shikaran survivors flee, aids Teferi in freeing Daria, and works with Freyalise to restore Corondor.
events.quote: He also aided Teferi in liberating Daria from her Amber Prison
